_readme: Manual corrections to skopje-pois.db that OSM doesn't have (yet).
The DB is gitignored and REGENERATED by the weekly OSM rebuild —
without this file every manual fix would silently vanish.
After any OSM rebuild or after editing this file, run:
npx tsx scripts/apply_overrides.ts
Sections:
pois      — POIs missing from OSM (name/type/lat/lon + why)
excluded  — places considered for capture and deliberately REJECTED,
with the reason (so the decision is reviewable and is not
re-litigated every time someone asks 'why is X not on the map')
addresses — individual house numbers missing from OSM
aliases   — feed spelling differs from OSM spelling (one-letter
typos, old street names, garbled feed names); every row
of 'osmStreet' is duplicated under the key of 'street'
so geocodeAddress() matches
WHAT BELONGS IN 'pois' (the inclusion criterion, applied to every entry
above): a PUBLIC PLACE a stranger can recognise and navigate by, because a
landmark is served in the sentence 'во близина на X' to a client who is
being denied the exact address. Every existing row is a supermarket, mall,
school or embassy on that test. A private company office fails it: the
client cannot walk to 'кај Kantar Brima'.
pinfixes  — move ONE row's pin without losing its place_id/rating
(a capture may refine a pin, never relocate the place)

deidentify — strip a Google identity the accept rule should never have
               welded to this row (the card's name was a KIND, or the row is a
               different place); keeps the correction across OSM rebuilds

excluded.name: Кантар Брима / Kantar BRIMA
excluded.reason: Kantar BRIMA is the Skopje office of the Kantar/TNS market-research company (founded 1991, ESOMAR member) — a private corporate office, not a public navigable place. It is absent from BOTH source datasets: not in the OSM import (0 rows in skopje-pois.db) and not in Google Maps local results (SerpApi google_maps, 'Kantar Brima Skopje' — 0 results, no error). Capture was requested for EB 94, whose area already serves the real, well-known „Рептил“ (supermarket, 7m). Adding it would spend one of the three rotation slots on a place no client recognises, so it is deliberately NOT captured. If it becomes a public venue, add it above with a verifiable coordinate — the mechanism is one 'pois' entry, no code change.

pois.name: Клинички центар
pois.note: [18:56] 'STANCE ZA PRODAVANJE KAJ DRZAVNA BOLNICA' — the УКЦ „Мајка Тереза“ complex (OSM way 32687572, bbox 41.9866-41.9907 / 21.4177-21.4269) that Skopjani call државна болница. The import kept its 20 individual clinics (Клиника за Кардиологија …) but DROPPED the complex itself, so the one place everybody navigates by had no row and the funnel asked the client for a location he had just named.
